Health writer Max Lugavere talks with Rogan, in a segment of the Joe Rogan Experience, about Alzheimer's drugs and the studies behind them. Lugavere wrote Genius Foods after his own mother's decline pushed him into brain-health research. His manner is that of a worried son turned reporter.

He walks through the new drugs, what the trial data actually showed, and why he finds the results thin for the price and risk. Rogan asks what families can do now, from food to sleep. The segment is a careful, plain-spoken review of a feared disease's hardest science, made for the many listeners caring for a parent.

Historians Dan Carlin and Daniele Bolelli share episode 413 of the Joe Rogan Experience, from the show's early days. Carlin hosts Hardcore History, the marathon podcast famous for gripping war stories. Bolelli, a martial artist and history teacher, wrote and taught on battles and fighters.

The three talk war, empires, and the men who fought through history's worst days. Carlin brings his slow, dramatic storytelling style to the table. Bolelli adds the view of a fighter who studies how combat shaped cultures. For history fans, it is two of podcasting's best teachers in one young, loose show.
